name: Christ Church Cathedral
scope: The exterior of the standing Christ Church Cathedral, including its local granite and brick nave, lower chancel, ancillary rooms and northwest bell and clock tower.
era: Sir Arthur Blomfield's cathedral consecrated in 1892, with its tower finished in 1903 and the roof renewed in 1991–92.

references.caption: Port Stanley, Falkland Islands, view from sea

originalReview.notes: Harley D. Nygren's original 1961 NOAA harbour view in Qualla shows the roof profile, north wall, bell tower and brick trim.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Used the exact original public-domain NOAA Corp1373 harbour photograph from the Qualla story gallery. Its file size and SHA-1 match the Commons transfer, whose first record identifies the government photo catalog, photographer and NOAA public-domain release.
